```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(alarmdata)
library(PL94171)
library(ggplot2)
library(redist)
library(ggredist)
library(sf)
options(scipen = 999)
```

### 2025 Texas Map

```{r}

# ALARM data map of Texas
map_texas <- alarm_50state_map("TX")

# PL 2020 data for Texas
pl_texas <- pl_read(pl_url("TX", year=2020))
# Block-level data with 15-digit GEOIDs that match PLANC2333
pl_texas_750 <- pl_subset(pl_texas, sumlev = "750")
# Derive the 11-digit GEOIDs from State + County + Voting District in PL
pl_texas_750$GEOID11 <- paste0(paste0(pl_texas_750$STATE, pl_texas_750$COUNTY), pl_texas_750$VTD)

# 2025 districts with associated 15-digit GEOIDs
texas_district_to_geoid <- readr::read_csv("PLANC2333/PLANC2333.csv")
texas_district_to_geoid <- texas_district_to_geoid |> mutate(SCTBKEY = as.character(SCTBKEY))

# Add the 2025 district #s by joining by 15-digit GEOIDs
pl_texas_750 <- left_join(pl_texas_750, texas_district_to_geoid, by = c("GEOID" = "SCTBKEY"))

# Make a new dataframe with just the derived 11-digit GEOIDs from PL and the 2025 district #s
texas_district_to_geoid11 <- pl_texas_750 |>
  select(GEOID11, DISTRICT) |>
  distinct(GEOID11, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add the district #s onto the ALARM data, joining by the 11-digit GEOIDs
map_texas <- left_join(map_texas, texas_district_to_geoid11, by = c("GEOID" = "GEOID11"))

# 2025 district map with 2020 vote share data
map_texas |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_district(aes(group = DISTRICT, fill = ndv, denom = nrv + ndv)) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()

# Precincts colored by vote share with district borders overlaid
map_texas |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = ndv / (nrv + ndv)), color = NA) +
    geom_district(aes(group=DISTRICT), linewidth=0.6, fill = NA) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()

map_texas |>
  group_by(cd_2020) |>
  summarize(
    total_ndv = sum(ndv, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nrv = sum(nrv, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(total_nrv > total_ndv) |>
  nrow()

map_texas |>
  group_by(DISTRICT) |>
  summarize(
    total_ndv = sum(ndv, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nrv = sum(nrv, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(total_nrv > total_ndv) |>
  nrow()

compet_talisman(plans = map_texas$cd_2020, shp = map_texas, rvote = nrv, dvote = ndv)
compet_talisman(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas, rvote = nrv, dvote = ndv)
```

### Texas Demographics with Old vs New Districts

```{r}
race_palette <- c(
  "Hispanic" = "#e67e22",
  "White"    = "#3498db",
  "Black"    = "#2ecc71",
  "AIAN"     = "#e74c3c",
  "Asian"    = "#9b59b6",
  "NHPI"     = "#f1c40f",
  "Other"    = "#95a5a6",
  "Two+"     = "#faf705"
)

map_texas <- map_texas |> 
  mutate(majority_race = case_when(
    vap_hisp  == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Hispanic",
    vap_white == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "White",
    vap_black == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Black",
    vap_aian  == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "AIAN",
    vap_asian == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Asian",
    vap_nhpi  == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "NHPI",
    vap_other == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Other",
    vap_two   == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Two+",
    TRUE ~ "Multiple/Tie"
  ))

# calculate the majority race for the entire district - old districts
map_texas <- map_texas |>
  group_by(cd_2020) |>
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("vap_"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "tot_{.col}")
  ) |>
  mutate(old_district_majority_race = case_when(
    tot_vap_hisp  == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Hispanic",
    tot_vap_white == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "White",
    tot_vap_black == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Black",
    tot_vap_aian  == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "AIAN",
    tot_vap_asian == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Asian",
    tot_vap_nhpi  == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "NHPI",
    tot_vap_other == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Other",
    tot_vap_two   == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Two+",
    TRUE ~ "Multiple/Tie"
  )) |>
  select(-starts_with("tot_")) |>
  ungroup()

# calculate the majority race for the entire district - new districts
map_texas <- map_texas |>
  group_by(DISTRICT) |>
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("vap_"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "tot_{.col}")
  ) |>
  mutate(new_district_majority_race = case_when(
    tot_vap_hisp  == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Hispanic",
    tot_vap_white == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "White",
    tot_vap_black == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Black",
    tot_vap_aian  == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "AIAN",
    tot_vap_asian == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Asian",
    tot_vap_nhpi  == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "NHPI",
    tot_vap_other == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Other",
    tot_vap_two   == pmax(tot_vap_hisp, tot_vap_white, tot_vap_black, tot_vap_aian, 
                          tot_vap_asian, tot_vap_nhpi, tot_vap_other, tot_vap_two) ~ "Two+",
    TRUE ~ "Multiple/Tie"
  )) |>
  select(-starts_with("tot_")) |>
  ungroup()

map_texas |>
```

```{r}
## 2025 Texas map stats

# Proportion of republican votes compared to all votes across Texas
sum(map_texas$nrv) / (sum(map_texas$ndv) + sum(map_texas$nrv)) # 0.5374333
# Proportion of white vap compared to all vap in Texas
sum(map_texas$vap_white) / (sum(map_texas$vap)) # 0.4316149
# Proportion of Hispanic population compared to all population in Texas
sum(map_texas$vap_hisp) / (sum(map_texas$vap)) # 0.3616146
# Proportion of black population compared to all population in Texas
sum(map_texas$vap_black) / (sum(map_texas$vap)) # 0.1177707

aggregate_stats <- map_texas |>
  group_by(DISTRICT) |>
  summarize(
    total_rep_votes = sum(nrv, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_dem_votes = sum(ndv, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_vap_white = sum(vap_white, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_vap_hisp = sum(vap_hisp, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_vap_black = sum(vap_black, na.rm = TRUE),
    #total_vap = sum(vap, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarize(
    proportion_rep_districts = mean(total_rep_votes > total_dem_votes),
    majority_vap_white_districts = mean(total_vap_white == pmax(total_vap_white, total_vap_hisp, total_vap_black)),
    majority_vap_hisp_districts = mean(total_vap_hisp == pmax(total_vap_white, total_vap_hisp, total_vap_black)),
    majority_vap_black_districts = mean(total_vap_black == pmax(total_vap_white, total_vap_hisp, total_vap_black))
  )
# Proportion of districts that have republican voting majority
aggregate_stats$proportion_rep_districts # 0.7105263 <- increase from previous
# Proportion of districts that have white vap majority
aggregate_stats$majority_vap_white_districts # 0.6578947
# Proportion of districts that have Hispanic vap majority
aggregate_stats$majority_vap_hisp_districts # 0.2894737
# Proportion of districts that have black vap majority
aggregate_stats$majority_vap_black_districts # 0.05263158

# Mean Polsby compactness of districts
mean(comp_polsby(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas)) # 0.2136063 <- more compact
# Mean Reock compactness of districts
mean(comp_reock(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas)) # 0.3424788 <- more compact
# number of total county splits
splits_total(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas, admin = county)[1] # 56 <- less splits
# partisan symmetry
part_bias(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas, dvote = ndv, rvote = nrv)[1] # 0.1842105 <- biased more toward Republican side
# partisan efficiency
part_egap(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas, dvote = ndv, rvote = nrv)[1] # 0.1822141 <- even more wasted Dem votes compared to wasted Rep votes
# Compute Talismanic Redistricting Competitiveness Metric - might not use
compet_talisman(plans = map_texas$DISTRICT, shp = map_texas, dvote = ndv, rvote = nrv)[1] # 0.1634001 <- less competitive?
```
